notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the helper PythonObjectDriver was replaced by a direct Driver. A static result map cannot build the .sda/.csv/.xml paths that read_UVVis writes from its two string inputs, and it cannot translate the upstream bool return into DriverFailed; the card decision direct-driver is unchanged. No catalogue class binds this interface: cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor kinds, cap.thermal.setpoint.v1 binds thermal zone/incubator kinds, and cap.measure.spectrum.v1 requires wavelength inputs the method-file read does not accept. The three extension ids are listed in catalogue_requests. The fake returns 12 placeholder wells in plate_data; the real GetDataCopy reply has one field per well of the 24/48/96/384-well plate used by the method (spectramax_API.md:1444-1451). NOT COVERED: the full plate-data payload (the fake returns 12 placeholder wells, not a recorded plate); the fake also does not create the .sda/.csv/.xml files, it only reports the paths the real wrapper would write. The upstream wrapper has no temperature getter, so the driver reports the requested set point and no measured temperature or reached flag. The e-stop and the safe-state action call set_temperature(0.0), a queued SoftMax Pro command; the clone documents no independent hardware e-stop, so there is no estop_physical_ref, and an already-running read is not interrupted. The upstream waits on command-completion events (30 s default, 120 s for the read: spectramax.py:151-162, 242-244), so the stop is a software command, not a safety-rated channel. site-limits.example.json is an example overlay (0 to 37 Cel) and not a statement about any unit; the target-temperature bound remains operator_required. No hardware run was made: this package is model-authored and unreviewed, the loader refuses its R2 hardware backend until reviewed_by is set, and all evidence is the fake backend (contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
